title: Jing-Zhang Open Belt OSM context extract
transformation: Converted from the raw Overpass response to GeoJSON, stripped nonessential tag dictionaries, and split by transport/context layer to remain within formal-package JSON size limits.
limitations_zh: 仅用于道路、步道、轨道、站点、水系、绿地与公共设施的现状背景制图和概念分析；不作为官方红线、权属、法定规划控制、竣工现状保证或精确面积来源。
limitations_en: Used only for contextual mapping and concept analysis of roads, paths, railways, stations, waterways, green spaces and public facilities; not an official boundary, title, statutory planning control, as-built guarantee or precise-area source.
